title: Ночлежка / The rented wagon
location_set: Ulan-Ude freight yard (existing) + boxcar interior dressing
characters: Yard guard; Dasha (pink scarf); yard runner; wagon sleepers (silhouettes); Irina
summary: The guard has rented a boxcar as a paid flophouse. He opens it and finds a rider feeding. Dasha escapes with a forearm bite. The guard is bitten and still picks up his money. Irina times a ~3 min sprint that ends at a steam pipe beside her office.

title: Утром перезвоните / Call back in the morning
characters: Irina; dispatcher (V.O.); yard guard
summary: The dispatcher refuses Irina. The guard says "dog" and begs her not to report him. She packs the tapes and addresses the envelope to the Naran duty doctor. TITLE.

title: Нүхнийхэн / The manhole people
location_set: N12 courtyard + kiosk (existing) + heating-main manhole (new prop)
characters: Professor (NEW); Bilgüün (kiosk-boy, now named); kiosk seller; kids; water-can woman; bus driver (bg)
summary: A homeless ex-teacher climbs out of the steaming manhole and sells a dead man's boot. The kiosk seller refuses the boy bread on credit, and the Professor buys it for him. The boy's mother was "bitten by a dog" at the manhole; the Professor: "we ate those dogs last winter". Flu radio. Townspeople blame the homeless.

title: «Ганаа ирэхээр» / When Ganaa comes
characters: Tsetsegmaa; Nyamka; Bataa; Togoo
summary: Debt book; "Ganaa-will-pay is our currency"; Togoo refused vodka on credit; three homeless gone from the tunnel; Togoo used to sleep there. Party invitation goes to Togoo.

title: Дээд давхрын хүүхэд / The baby upstairs
characters: Dulmaa; Tsetsegmaa; Altan; Tungalag + infant; door neighbour
summary: Vodka hidden in the kitchen cupboard (plant). The kitchen door shown (inward, no lock). The upstairs newborn cries nonstop; gossip about Saraa. Altan runs to the door and finds only a neighbour, who needles Tsetsegmaa.

title: Бешеный / Rabid
characters: Ganaa; Pasha; yard runner (far bg)
summary: Pasha unpaid for three months, and the rouble joke. The "bomzh" standing at the pipe since five; the doctor-lady calls him rabid. Mittens go into Ganaa's coat.

title: Двадцать долларов / Twenty dollars
characters: Ganaa; Irina
summary: Irina can't go herself because the runner is there. A wagon of people went to Naran four days ago. She pays Ganaa $20. The satchel goes behind the driver's seat.

title: Звонок / The call back
characters: Irina; yard runner; dispatcher (V.O.)
summary: The dispatcher finally rings back. The bell rouses the runner and Irina dies off-screen. The receiver dangles: "again the bomzhi?"

title: Ногоон бичиг / Green paper
characters: Ganaa; Russian border officer; Mongolian customs officer
summary: The Russian stamp, then a Mongolian customs stall. Ganaa bribes with Irina's $20. "Ямар өдөр вэ, пизда." The satchel slips out of sight.

title: Буханка / The minibus
characters: Chenzh woman (NEW); minibus driver (V.O.); Dasha; Ganaa
summary: Shuttle traders dump the bleeding Dasha and keep her fare. Ganaa hesitates, then stops. The shared tea bowl (kindness, not infection). The photo.

title: Алёнка / The chocolate
characters: Ganaa; Dasha
summary: Her feral eating. "Оставь немного. Дочке." She pays him back with an Alenka bar for his daughter. "Собака."

title: Хөхүүлж байна гэдэг юм / Feeding, you mean (MIDPOINT)
location_set: Ganaa apartment + N12 4th-floor landing (new set variant)
characters: Tsetsegmaa; Dulmaa; Altan; Tungalag; Togoo; Khand (NEW name); female guest; older male guest; Bilgüün; Saraa (unseen)
summary: Party gossip about a Russian girl. The upstairs crying stops mid-breath. The boy arrives with an empty bottle and the key on his neck: "Ээж дүүг идэж байна." An adult corrects his grammar. Tungalag knocks on the locked door, the door slams, she laughs it off. The boy is sent out with buuz and sits on the stairs.

title: Халуун / Heat
location_set: KAMAZ cab + roadside sign (existing + new sign prop)
characters: Ganaa; Dasha
summary: Dasha presses against the heater. Ganaa passes a sum clinic sign and goes quiet.

title: Хүрэлийн гуанз / Hürel's café
characters: Ganaa; Hürel; card player; partner; Dasha
summary: The debt banter. The border took the money: "they have a stamp, you have buuz". Extra buuz, and a ledger page left unwritten.

title: Хэд вэ? / How much?
characters: Card player (second-driver asset); partner; Hürel; Ganaa; Dasha
summary: The card player prices Dasha like goods. "Битгий шаа." The gifts go into Ganaa's coat. Hürel reaches to catch her; her eyes go to his throat.

title: Шуу / The LEFT wrist
characters: Dasha; Hürel; Ganaa; card player; partner
summary: The attack. The card player steals the cash box and is abandoned by his partner. Hürel is lost. Dasha slams the truck door and bites Ganaa's LEFT wrist.

title: Гал / Fire
characters: Ganaa; livestock driver
summary: A localised fire. Ganaa tries for the cab and the satchel and fails. The livestock truck takes him.

title: Хайрцагтай хүн / The man with the box
characters: Ganaa; livestock driver; card player (on road)
summary: They pass the thief walking with the cash box. Flu radio, then the PROTECTED line verbatim. Sheep; the pulse; Ganaa's reflection.

title: Эмнэлгийн хаалга / The hospital gate
location_set: Clinic road + hospital gate N04 (existing) + gate railing
characters: Ganaa; livestock driver; orderly; policeman (NEW); Professor; queue (two hiding hands)
summary: Police tie the bitten homeless man to the railing and register the bitten. Others in the queue hide their hands and leave. The Professor sees Ganaa's wrist. Ganaa walks home.

title: Шат / The stairs
characters: Bilgüün; Ganaa; Tsetsegmaa; Sükhee; Dulmaa; guests
summary: The boy: "Та ч бас нохойд хазуулсан уу?" Heavy steps upstairs. Ganaa arrives home and lies: "cut on something". He snaps at Dulmaa.

title: Таазны тоос / Ceiling dust
characters: Sükhee; Togoo; Ganaa; Tsetsegmaa; Dulmaa
summary: Togoo denied a drink. The bone crack. A thump upstairs, plaster in Sükhee's vodka ("seasoning"). "Дараа."

title: Бээлий / The mittens
characters: Ganaa; Altan; Tsetsegmaa; guests; Togoo (bg)
summary: Mittens, slightly big. The chocolate with a blood thumbprint, pocketed by Tsetsegmaa. The off-key song. Togoo slips into the kitchen in the background.

title: Нөгөө өрөөнөөс / The cry
characters: Tungalag; Ganaa; Altan; Tsetsegmaa
summary: The guest infant cries. The song cuts off; Tungalag remembers. "Алтан..." Ganaa turns away from the bedroom.

title: Хаалга / The door
characters: Ganaa; Tsetsegmaa; Dulmaa; Altan; Togoo (O.S.)
summary: "Цэцгээ... хүүхдүүдийг..." Ganaa shuts himself inside the inward-opening door. A muffled voice that isn't his, a cry, a thud.

title: ENDING B / The bottle
characters: Sükhee; Tsetsegmaa; Altan; Ganaa (O.S.); Togoo (hand only)
summary: Sükhee pushes. The door stops against a body. The vodka bottle rolls out to Altan's slipper. A fingerless glove on the lino. Exhale/inhale. CUT. End card 10 s.
